body:
After a night of going to a club and having a pretty drab experience not doing anything, I felt the urge to get messed up, normally I would just smoke or take some hydro-morphone, but after reading up on DXM I felt like it would be a nice experience before bed (I never got to sleep that night).
11:30- took 250mg of DXM HBr (only active ingredient)
11:50- slight auditory euphoria and a feeling of dizzyness
12:15- I felt I was not getting the trip I really wanted so I decided to add some caffeine to the mix I drank 3 cups of fairly strong coffee, with a large amount of sugar
12:45- Still only the effects of DXM with being a little more edgy
1:00- This is when everything started to kick in I was sitting down in a chair talking online when all of a sudden I almost blacked out and I feel very overwhelmed by everything, I turned off my computer and all my lights, I was forced to lay down or else I would have fell to the ground. I started to experience mild hallucinations when I closed my eyes (faces, hammers, and lights coming towards my head (Don't ask me?!?!))
1:45-2:30- I do not remember this time at all I know I did not fall asleep. I think I blacked out, when I came around I was still experiencing the effects I was at 1:00
3:00- I felt like I needed to get some fresh air so I went outside and after returning to my room I was overwhelmed by a new feeling a great feeling of panic. For some dumb reason I was worried about not getting sleep this night even though it hasn't been a problem in the past and I was worried about my girlfriend for some odd reason. I have no idea why but I was very overwhelmed by this and I once again was forced to lay down
3:30- I suddenly made the connection that this somewhat reminded me of the one time I took E (I took 2 250mg anchors) and I had somewhat the same experience but without the feeling of panic
5:00- all effects of the small amount of DMX were gone however the caffeine was still running rampant and was soon effected by what I call 'the shakes'
6:00- At this point I was well aware I was not going to sleep for the rest of the day
This was a somewhat great experience except for the panic and the insomnia, I will do this again except without the caffeine and a much larger dose of DMX (I was surprised by the effect of that small dose of DMX)
Good feelings, have fun
